title: Five-Word Discrete Vocabulary Joint BiGAN Smoke (1800s Wall Cap)
intuition: Calibrated 1,800-second wall-cap variant of `five_word_joint_smoke` testing whether public joint BiGAN training with 5 learned 2D particles acquires all five words and reconstructs every paired input at one independently confirmed state over 20,001 updates.
failure_mode: Two words collide onto one particle or encoder inversion drifts before all five discrete words settle cleanly; separates true numerical failures from 900s wall-time timeouts on slower GPUs.
protocol_notes: Calibrated 1800s timeout variant preserving legacy `five_word_joint_smoke` at 900s byte-identical.
